name: ogawa929
description: A personal plugin marketplace for Claude Code, hosting a curated collection of reusable skills.

plugins.name: hello-world
plugins.description: A minimal example plugin with a single /hello-world:greet skill — useful as a template for building your own plugins.

plugins.name: impl-flow
plugins.description: Breaks a feature down into commit-sized implementation plans and executes them with subagents. Run /impl-flow:spec (design+plan) and /impl-flow:implement independently, or /impl-flow:all for the full pipeline in one go.

plugins.name: reduce-hallucinations
plugins.description: Adds a research/investigation skill that grounds Claude's answers in direct quotes and citations, and permits acknowledging uncertainty. Only activates for investigation-style tasks, so it stays out of the way during implementation.
